A3 (Theo, owner of PF2) attempted to reveal PF2 at turn 1 and again at turn 4, but both times produced malformed JSON (`{"type":" "reveal", ...}` with a stray space and quote), so the reveals were never registered — revealed_facts contains only PF1. At turn 7, A3 conveyed the same scheduling information via a plain `say` action, and A1 incorporated it into the settlement (meeting_day=Thursday, meeting_start=15:30, meeting_end=16:15), but because no formal `reveal` of PF2 occurred, the settlement's credited_facts and justification_fact_ids listed only PF1. This caused C6 (which requires both PF1 and PF2 to be credited) and P1 (provenance, same requirement) to fail. The other three rollouts (0, 1, 2) all revealed and credited both PF1 and PF2 correctly, passing every check. With pass_count=3 and min_pass_required=3, the gate appears to have failed on a strict or additional threshold condition tied to C6 and P1 each only reaching 3/4.
